name: Vladislav Hushcha
tagline: I build fast websites and the tools behind them

items.proof: Shipped a C++ → WebAssembly course planner and an open-source npm package this year.
I like going one layer down: from React to WebAssembly, from the UI to the build.
Sites I build load in under a second, this one included.
Started a coding club and taught younger students for a year and a half.
Built a campus issue-reporting app with a team in one hackathon weekend.
